This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
This Yoga Nidra is a journey of deep release and rebirth.
There was a time when I didn’t realise how much tension the body silently holds. Stress, fatigue, old emotions, trauma, even fear gets physically stored in our bodies. We keep carrying it without knowing. Over time, I understood that Yoga Nidra - a profound state of conscious relaxation - can help us release these burried emotions.
